features.title: Featured Features
features.subtitle: Custom-built systems designed exclusively to deliver polished, immersive, and enduring gameplay.

proximity.title: Proximity Voice Chat
proximity.desc: Communicate with other players using integrated proximity voice chat. Hear whispers in city alleys, make secret deals, or shout warnings in intense battles.

economy.title: Crystal Economy
economy.desc: A dynamic financial ecosystem. Mine unstable crystals in the depths, refine them in refineries, and use them to acquire ships, trade at auctions, or pay city taxes.

nations.title: Nations & Empires
nations.desc: Found your own town or join an existing nation. Enact laws, manage municipal treasuries, sign peace treaties, or declare territorial wars to expand your empire.

roles.badge: Custom Mechanics System Built to Measure
roles.title: Choose Your Path in CrystalTides
roles.subtitle: The main goal of the server is to be fun and have a great time playing, whether relaxing (chill) with friends or tryharding to climb the rankings. Your progress unlocks cosmetic titles and prestige levels.
roles.step1_desc: Build, fight, trade, or explore freely. No playstyle restrictions.
roles.step2_desc: Accumulate blocks, kills, KilluCoins, or streak days to unlock progressive titles.
roles.step3_desc: Advance through 5 global Prestige tiers and compete for the supreme rank in your branch.
roles.prestige_desc: Prestige Tiers reward the dedication of players who max out their mastery statistics in CrystalTides.
roles.track_desc: Link your Minecraft account to update your badges.

rules.sub: Requirements to dispute the Top #1 spot
rules.max_rank_req: You must be the player with the highest points/stats in the category you excel in.
rules.limit_active: You can only hold 1 maximum title simultaneously at any given time.
rules.transfer: Transferred if another player surpasses your score. 1v1 Duel is exclusive to Warlord.

constructor.title: Builder & Colonizer
constructor.subtitle: Architectural Art & Kingdoms
constructor.desc: Master the art of architecture and found kingdoms. Design protected megastructures and connect the world through trade routes, ports, and cities.
constructor.formula: Blocks mined + placed. Each block milestone grants you a new building rank.
constructor.topReq: Highest combined sum of mined and placed blocks on the server

rule.0: Blocks must be placed and mined organically by playing in the survival world.
rule.1: Artificial block looping (repeatedly breaking and placing the same block with scripts or macros) is strictly prohibited.
rule.2: Megastructures in protected claims receive official validation on the interactive server map.

luchador.title: Fighter & Gladiator
luchador.subtitle: PvP, Mobs & Dungeons
luchador.desc: Conquer the depths and dominate the arena. Defeat bosses in weekly dungeons, secure event control chests, and lead your clan to glory.
luchador.formula: 15 pts per player PvP kill and 1 pt per hostile mob eliminated.
luchador.topReq: Highest combined score of PvP Kills and Dungeon boss defeats on the server

rule.0: PvP kills count only between distinct players without clan alliance.
rule.1: Kill farming (repeatedly killing the same account or alts) results in a complete reset of combat stats.
rule.2: Dungeons and control events award temporary score multipliers during weekly events.

mercader.title: Merchant & Tycoon
mercader.subtitle: Economy & KilluCoins
mercader.desc: Control server markets. Trade with players, auction rare items, and accumulate KilluCoins to rule the financial leaderboards.
mercader.formula: Logarithmic scale (100 × log₁₀(KilluCoins)). The higher your capital, the higher your economic rank.
mercader.topReq: Highest accumulated fortune in KilluCoins (logarithmic scale)

rule.0: Financial balances are audited in real time via the server economic plugin.
rule.1: Fictitious transfers or temporary KilluCoin loans between secondary accounts before ranking cutoff are prohibited.
rule.2: Player shops and auction sales award commercial prestige bonuses.

constancia.title: Constancy & Loyalty
constancia.subtitle: Daily Streaks & Fidelity
constancia.desc: Loyalty has rewards. Maintain daily login streaks, participate actively in events, and strengthen the server community.
constancia.formula: Quadratic growth (Streak Days)². Rewards maximum fidelity without breaking daily logins.
constancia.topReq: Longest uninterrupted daily login streak with highest quadratic score on the server

rule.0: Daily streaks reset if you fail to log in for at least 15 active minutes within a 24-hour window.
rule.1: Excessive AFK with automated machines to inflate playtime without active gameplay is prohibited.
rule.2: Active members receive daily reward multipliers and loyalty reward chests.

explorador.title: Explorer & Cartographer
explorador.subtitle: Journeys & Rare Biomes
explorador.desc: Traverse the far reaches of the survival world, discover legendary structures, claim treasure maps, and chart uncharted lands.
explorador.formula: 10 pts per active playtime hour + 1 pt per km (1,000 blocks) traveled in Minecraft.
explorador.topReq: Highest combined score of active playtime hours and distance traveled

rule.0: Distance counts across all movement types (walking, riding, flying with elytra).
rule.1: Automated elytra or boat looping scripts without manual navigation are monitored and penalized.
rule.2: Discovering rare biomes and structures unlocks bonus exploration score.

history_section.desc: Welcome to the history of CrystalTides SMP, where you can explore the project timeline and milestones.

stage2.banner_text: What began as a great friendship gave birth to something wonderful. CrystalTidesSMP is not just a server; it is the reflection of our commitment to building a transparent digital home, crafted with empathy and by listening to our community.
stage2.summary: The official team forms: Killu leading voice & community, Nero on tech & infrastructure, Churly on UI design, and Japa on game testing.

killu.desc: Passionate, cheerful, and the protective soul of the Fishbowl. Creates a welcoming vibe, organizes events, and guides with human warmth.

nero.desc: Logical mind injected with technical euphoria. Obsessed with server performance, custom patches, and clean bug-free code.

churly.desc: Visual perfectionist, creative and aesthetic visionary. Designs interfaces, art concepts, and unique visual identities.

japa.desc: Curious, persistent, and relentless seeking to break mechanics to improve them. Killu's personal fault-proof agent of chaos.

stage3.title: Evolution to CrystalTides SMP
stage3.subtitle: RPG System, LIVE Economy & Nether Bosses
stage3.summary: The fishbowl evolved into CrystalTides SMP, a brand new server with fresh mechanics and epic bosses.
stage3.f1_desc: Complete RPG system for mastery & combat

stage4.title: Dedicated Era & Launcher
stage4.subtitle: Dedicated Servers, Official Domain & Future
stage4.summary: Migration to enterprise Ubuntu Server infrastructure (MySQL, Redis, distributed nodes), official domain, and Launcher Beta.

rules.title: Server Rules
rules.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this rule?
rules.intro: To maintain a healthy and fun community, it is essential to respect these coexistence rules. Failure to comply can lead to severe sanctions.
rules.no_results: No rules found in this category.

1.title: PVP With Consent
1.desc: PVP is allowed as long as it is agreed upon between 2 or more players. Do not abuse a player who does not want PVP.

2.title: No Stealing or Griefing
2.desc: Stealing is prohibited. You can trade or help, but not loot. Destroying property or killing pets will be punished with a permaban. We use Core Protect.

3.title: Village Bases
3.desc: If you live in a village, leave a VISIBLE sign or wall so others know it is occupied and do not loot it or harm the villagers.

4.title: Automated Farms
4.desc: 100% automatic constructions and villager/iron farms are prohibited. Exception: Semi-automatic farms with manual activation.

5.title: No Mega Builds
5.desc: Giant castles spanning too many CHUNKS are not allowed. Build large villages, but avoid massive individual structures.

6.title: Biome Cleanup
6.desc: You must undo temporary constructions that mar the landscape (dirt pillars, cobble bridges, etc).

7.title: Aesthetics
7.desc: Constructions must be aesthetically pleasing. Avoid doing things 'halfway' or without effort.

8.title: Streaming and Community
8.desc: Free to stream giving credit to Killu and Neroferno. Invite friends as long as they respect the rules and join Discord.

9.title: Reports and Safety
9.desc: Use /co inspect to check for thefts. Contact Killu for claims. Do not take justice into your own hands.
